text:
Sofia Nguyen: Quick pre-cutover check — planning to push v1.14.0 annotated tag and create the GitHub draft release in ~30m. Changeset PR is merged (#421). Can owners confirm the draft has the linux amd64 artifact + sbom and that CHANGELOG.md has the upgrade notes? Also need sha256 for linux-amd64.tgz.

Jamal Ortiz: On it, pulling artifacts from the CI bucket now. Will upload sbom if missing.

Maria Chen: I can sweep the changelog, saw a tiny wording quirk under 'breaking changes' — will push a 1-line edit. Who's doing the signed tag? @Andre Patel?

Andre Patel: I can create the annotated + signed tag. Need KMS passphrase window from Ops to sign. Will hold until @Jon confirms.

release-bot: draft release updated (automated): assets found: linux-amd64.tgz (12.1MB) -> present, sbom.json -> missing. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/tag/v1.14.0-draft

Sofia Nguyen: Jamal, once sbom is uploaded can you paste the `sha256` line here so I can pin it in the release body?

Jamal Ortiz: Uploaded sbom.json. sha256 below:
```
abc123def4567890cafe...  linux-amd64.tgz
```
(Putting full checksum into GH release body now)

Maria Chen: LGTM on changelog after my tiny tweak — added 'Upgrade notes' entry. :thumbsup:

Jon Alvarez: KMS unlock granted for 15m window starting now. Good for signing. :lock:

Andre Patel: I have the tag locally and signed:
```
git tag -s v1.14.0 -m "v1.14.0 - release"
git push origin v1.14.0
```
Pushing tag and creating draft release body in 30s. Waiting for CI notarization. @ci-bot — please watch for artifact signing.

ci-bot: Notarization pipeline started (#871). Artifact signing in progress. Will post status.

Andre Patel: Pushed annotated & signed tag, and created draft release with the changelog and checksum. Notarization CI passed. Pipeline: https://ci.internal/redwood/871

Sofia Nguyen: Perfect — starting the RC cutover in +10m. If anything flaps: fallback is `git push --delete origin v1.14.0` and reopen previous draft. Thanks all :rocket:
